name: perplexity-search
description: Web search via Perplexity's x402 endpoint (paysponge gateway), routed through the SELAT Router. Returns ranked web results with page content and source URLs for the agent to synthesize into a cited answer. Paid per call (USDC on Base), no API key.

query.description: The web search query (maps to Perplexity /search `query`).

recency.description: Publication recency filter: one of hour | day | week | month | year (Perplexity /search `search_recency_filter`).

steps.label: web search — Perplexity /search (routed x402 via SELAT Router)
